title: Trail and Wreck
author: Gideon Eastwick
blurb: Petra Lockridge, a railroad engineer with a map of closed lines, carries a compass, a debt, and very little else. But when the river gives up a chest stamped with a dead nation's seal, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, they must beat the salvage fleet to the wreck by six tides before the concession permits expire.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
